title: Zesty Vietnamese Daikon Bun Rieu
description: Spicy and chewy Vietnamese dish featuring daikon and ferment-kimchi, served in a scallop shell, this macrobiotic-friendly bun rieu is perfect for midnight cravings. It combines the flavors of daikon, kimchi, and various spices.
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large pot, combine the vegetable broth, soy sauce, and sesame oil, and bring to a boil.
Add the grated daikon to the pot and cook until it is tender.
Add the chopped ferment-kimchi to the pot and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes.
To serve, place some cooked noodles in the bottom of a scallop shell, then spoon the daikon and kimchi mixture over the noodles.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients.
